verdict.rationale: Kick documents its own Platform API, with per-operation OpenAPI 3.0.2 reference pages (server use.kick.co/api, e.g. workspaces.list) and a Bearer-token 'Test it' runner. The API is explicitly not yet public, though: access is enabled per organization by the Kick team, and there is no single downloadable spec (the standard openapi.json paths return 404). Missing for 10: general public availability, a consolidated downloadable OpenAPI spec, broader documented endpoint coverage, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Kick documents a Platform API whose reference pages embed complete per-operation OpenAPI 3.0.2 documents
The API reference renders GitBook's OpenAPI explorer with a "Test it" runner per operation (Bearer-token requests against use.kick.co).
